title: Checkout par coupon do baar laga, aur koi bhi customer doosre customer ki invoice download kar sakta tha
summary:
Release se pehle checkout aur order history ke pages test karte hue do ghaltiyan mili. Dono is branch par theek ho chuki hain.

Jab customer cart ka page refresh karta tha to coupon doosri dafa lag jata tha, is liye test run ke 1,240 orders kam charge hue (kul USD 3,180). Doosri ghalti: invoice download ka link kisi bhi order number ko qubool kar leta tha. Logged-in customer address bar mein number badal kar kisi aur ki invoice, us ke naam, pate aur saman samet, download kar sakta tha.

Ab coupon sirf ek dafa cart ke subtotal se nikalta hai aur order ke saath save hota hai, aur har invoice sirf signed-in customer ke apne orders se load hoti hai. Dono rules ke naye tests hain, aur ek insaan ne do alag customer accounts se haath se dobara jaanch ki.

problems.title: Cart refresh karne par coupon ka discount do baar lag jata tha
problems.symptom: USD 50.00 ke cart par 10% coupon ke baad ek refresh karne se total USD 45.00 ki jagah USD 40.50 aa gaya.
problems.root_cause: `applyCoupon()` discount asal subtotal ke bajaye maujooda total se kaat raha tha, aur har cart refresh par dobara chalta tha. Kahin yeh darj nahi tha ke coupon pehle lag chuka hai.
problems.impact: Staging test run mein 9,800 mein se 1,240 orders kam charge hue, kul USD 3,180. Production mein yeh aamdani ka nuqsan aur manual refunds ya dobara billing hoti.
problems.evidence:
Test order SF-20261029-0417: subtotal 50.00, coupon SAVE10, charge 40.50.
Cart log mein ek hi cart ke liye 4 seconds ke andar `applyCoupon` do baar chala.

problems.title: Invoice download yeh check nahi karta tha ke order kis ka hai
problems.symptom: Test customer A ke taur par sign in kar ke `/api/orders/1002/invoice` kholne se customer B ki invoice download ho gayi.
problems.root_cause: Route order ko `Order.findById(req.params.id)` se load karta tha aur sirf yeh dekhta tha ke koi signed in hai, yeh nahi ke order usi ka hai. Order numbers silsilewar hain, is liye aasani se andaaza lagaya ja sakta hai.
problems.impact: Koi bhi customer doosron ke naam, pate, phone numbers aur khareedari parh sakta tha: personal data ka leak, jise kai mulkon mein report karna zaroori hota hai.
problems.evidence: Customer A (id 77) ki taraf se order 1002 (customer 81 ka) ki request par HTTP 200 aur PDF wapas aayi.

fixes.title: Coupon sirf ek dafa, subtotal se nikalna
fixes.change: Discount ab `cart.subtotal` se nikalta hai, aur laga hua coupon cart par save hota hai. Wahi coupon dobara lagane se kuch nahi badalta. Database mein (cart_id, coupon_code) par unique index duplicate ko rokta hai.
fixes.why_correct: Total ab is par mabni nahi ke page kitni dafa load hua, aur do requests ek saath aayein to bhi database doosri copy qubool nahi karta.

fixes.title: Invoice sirf customer ke apne orders se load karna
fixes.change: Route ab order ko order id aur signed-in customer ki id, dono se dhoondta hai, aur match na ho to 404 deta hai.
fixes.why_correct: Customer sirf apne orders tak pohanch sakta hai. 404 jawab yeh bhi nahi batata ke kisi aur ka order maujood hai ya nahi.

fixes.title: Dono rules ke tests
fixes.change: Naye tests: cart teen dafa refresh karne par bhi ek hi discount; customer A ko customer B ki invoice par 404 aur apni par 200.
fixes.why_correct: Dono tests purane code par fail hue aur naye par pass, is liye yahi ghalti wapas aaye to foran pakdi jayegi.

verification.detail: 214 tests, 0 failures; 2 naye tests fix se pehle fail hote the.
Koi HIGH ya WARN baqi nahi; 2 INFO bahar jane wali calls ke, dono mutawaqqe.
Tabdeeli mein istemal har function, import aur route maujood hai.

verification.check: Do customer accounts se manual test
verification.detail: Customer A, customer B ki invoice nahi khol saka; dono apni apni khol sake.

verification.check: Coupon ke saath checkout 5 dafa refresh
verification.detail: USD 50.00 ke cart par SAVE10 ke saath total USD 45.00 hi raha.
Approve kiya, ek note ke saath: baad mein `invoicePath` ka naam `invoiceFilePath` karein.
Release candidate ke liye plan hai.

scans.note: Fix se pehle wala HIGH invoice route tha jo request ki id se order parh raha tha, bina ownership check ke.

approvals.action: Nayi migration local database par chalana
approvals.harm: Unique index add hota hai; agar pehle se duplicate rows hon to fail ho jati hai

approvals.action: Wahi migration shared staging database par chalana
approvals.harm: Carts table kuch seconds ke liye lock hoti hai; doosre testers ko tabdeeli foran nazar aati hai

remaining_risks: Staging mein jo orders kam charge hue, data kahin aur copy hone se pehle unhein theek karna zaroori hai.
Doosre download routes (receipts, shipping labels) bhi yahi tareeqa use karte hain aur abhi check nahi hue.
next_steps: Tay shuda khamosh waqt mein staging par migration chalayein.
Receipts aur shipping-label routes mein bhi yahi ownership check dekhein.
Release se pehle checkout ka load test chalayein.
